def check_constraints():
    from z3 import (Int, Const, Function, DeclareSort, Solver,
                    And, Not, BitVec, BitVecSort, BitVecVal, sat)

    # --- Sorts for structs / pointers ---
    SlType     = DeclareSort('SlType')
    RefType    = DeclareSort('RefType')
    ParentType = DeclareSort('ParentType')

    # --- sl fields ---
    sl_list_count      = Function('sl_list_count', SlType, Int)
    sl_nb_ref_mods     = Function('sl_nb_ref_modifications', SlType, Int, Int)
    sl_ref_count       = Function('sl_ref_count', SlType, Int, Int)
    sl_ref_list_parent = Function('sl_ref_list_parent', SlType, Int, Int, ParentType)
    sl_ref_list_pic_id = Function('sl_ref_list_pic_id', SlType, Int, Int, Int)

    # --- ref fields ---
    ref_long_ref  = Function('ref_long_ref', RefType, ParentType)
    ref_pic_id    = Function('ref_pic_id', RefType, Int)
    ref_frame_num = Function('ref_frame_num', RefType, Int)

    # --- h fields ---
    h_short_ref_count = Function('h_short_ref_count', SlType, Int)

    # --- free variables ---
    ref_int       = Int('ref')
    sl            = Const('sl', SlType)
    ref           = Const('ref', RefType)
    pic_structure = Int('pic_structure')
    frame_num     = Int('frame_num')

    # Loop indices
    list  = Int('list')
    index = Int('index')
    i     = Int('i')

    # --- Constraint 1 ---
    block1 = And(list == 0, list < sl_list_count(sl))
    block2 = And(index == 0, index < sl_nb_ref_mods(sl, list))
    block3 = (i >= 0)
    block4 = And(i == index, i + 1 < sl_ref_count(sl, list))

    null_parent = Const('null_parent', ParentType)
    parent_val  = sl_ref_list_parent(sl, list, i)
    block5 = And(
        parent_val != null_parent,
        ref_long_ref(ref) == parent_val,
        ref_pic_id(ref)   == sl_ref_list_pic_id(sl, list, i)
    )

    bad_case_1 = And(block1, block2, block3, block4, block5)
    constraint_1 = Not(bad_case_1)

    # --- Constraint 2 ---
    c2_block1 = And(list == 0, list < sl_list_count(sl))
    c2_block2 = And(index == 0, index < sl_nb_ref_mods(sl, list))
    c2_block3 = And(i == h_short_ref_count(sl) - 1, i >= 0)

    ref_reference_bv = Function('ref_reference_bv', RefType, BitVecSort(32))
    pic_structure_bv = BitVec('pic_structure_bv', 32)
    c2_block4 = And(
        ref_frame_num(ref) == frame_num,
        (ref_reference_bv(ref) & pic_structure_bv) != BitVecVal(0, 32)
    )

    bad_case_2 = And(c2_block1, c2_block2, c2_block3, c2_block4)
    constraint_2 = Not(bad_case_2)

    # --- Solver ---
    s = Solver()
    s.add(ref_int == 0)   # from base script
    s.add(constraint_1)
    s.add(constraint_2)

    return s.check() == sat
